1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
Heard learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner who contends that the impugned proceedings as well as the Show Cause Notice is wholly without jurisdiction.
According to him, the same are highly belated and issued much after the expiry of the time-limits prescribed under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the rules framed thereunder.
2. Issue notice.
